questions.stem: The BHAKRA NANGAL dam is built across which river?
questions.explanation: Bhakra Nangal — Sutlej river, at the border of Himachal Pradesh and Punjab. India's SECOND-TALLEST straight-gravity dam (~226 m). Nehru called it 'the new temple of resurgent India'. Gobind Sagar is its reservoir. Irrigation + hydroelectric power.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the DAM with its RIVER. A. Hirakud.  B. Nagarjuna Sagar.  C. Sardar Sarovar.  D. Tehri. List-II: 1. Mahanadi.  2. Krishna.  3. Narmada.  4. Bhagirathi.
questions.explanation: Hirakud (Odisha, world's longest earthen dam, ~26 km long) — Mahanadi. Nagarjuna Sagar — Krishna (Telangana-AP border). Sardar Sarovar — Narmada (Gujarat). Tehri — Bhagirathi (Uttarakhand, India's TALLEST dam ~260 m).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.explanation: Tehri (Uttarakhand) — 260.5 m, India's tallest; on Bhagirathi river. Among world's tallest. Capacity 3.5 cubic km. Bhakra Nangal (~226 m) — second. Sardar Sarovar (~163 m). Hirakud — long but not tall (~61 m).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: World's LONGEST EARTHEN dam, Hirakud, is in which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Hirakud — Sambalpur, Odisha (opened 1957 by Nehru). Length ~26 km (with dykes). Built across the Mahanadi. Multi-purpose: flood control, irrigation, power. Other river dams on Mahanadi: Naraj barrage, Mundali.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: SARDAR SAROVAR DAM is built on the NARMADA river and is located in:
questions.explanation: Sardar Sarovar — Navagam, Narmada district, Gujarat. Height 163 m (now; raised through Narmada Control Authority rulings). Linked to Sardar Sarovar Project — benefits Gujarat, MP, Maharashtra, Rajasthan. Centre of decades-long Narmada Bachao Andolan protests led by Medha Patkar.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: INDIRA GANDHI Canal — the longest canal in India — draws water from the:
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi Canal / IGNP — starts at Harike barrage (confluence of Sutlej + Beas in Punjab) and irrigates northwestern Rajasthan (Sriganganagar, Hanumangarh, Bikaner, Jaisalmer). Longest canal in India (~650 km). Transformed desert land into cropland. Harike barrage in Punjab.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

_fixes.was: Sutlej and Beas (Harike barrage in Punjab)

questions.stem: The MULTI-PURPOSE Damodar Valley project is associated with:
questions.explanation: Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) — India's first multi-purpose river valley project, 1948. Inspired by the US Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA). Covers parts of Jharkhand + West Bengal. Key dams: Tilaiya, Konar, Maithon, Panchet. Damodar was earlier called 'Sorrow of Bengal' due to floods.
